verdict.rationale: Better Auth is a library you install via npm and run inside your own app. It uses your own SQLite, PostgreSQL or MySQL database, so the core product is inherently self-hosted. Community users confirm that all auth data lives in their own DB, that it is free versus Clerk or Supabase, and call it the best open-source TypeScript option. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party open-source license and self-hosting statement in the docs, and clarity on which features are enterprise-only (one user notes some advanced features such as SAML/SCIM are enterprise-gated).
